design_condition: The compact building is well inserted into its surroundings with good distance from neighbouring buildings, while its access is organized through a compact, structured arrival sequence.

positive.statement: The project is compact and well inserted into the surrounding context, with good distance from other buildings.
The compact access via Mola is very interesting and well structured.
The ground floor brilliantly resolves the height constraints of a four-storey building through differentiated and convincing spatial events.
The classroom plans develop the space program coherently, modularly, and flexibly.
The project is the most convincing in developing the client's concept of new school teaching.
The construction method has good potential for containing costs and construction times.
The project presents the best potential for possible certification in the field.

negative.statement: A different solution for bicycle parking would be sensible.
